run_convert_segmentation: run the hydra-configured script to convert instance segmentation masks into per-target PNG files across video frames
run_load_instance: run load_instance to load a PyTorch checkpoint and return predicted boxes and masks as NumPy arrays
run_find_max_overlap_box_index: run find_max_overlap_box_index to find the box with maximum overlap ratio against a reference box
run_box_area: run box_area to compute the area of a bounding box given its four coordinates
run_box_overlap: run box_overlap to compute the overlapping area between two bounding boxes
